baseline.releasePackage: published lumen-reach-v0.10.3 archive (extracted; sha256 17e1bca6...c23c verified against the release)

changes.residents: Four starter-kit residents (world format 0.9), one per area: Desert (Sun Court), Crimson (Array Hall), Ember (Rime Vault), Blue (Signal Rise). Each walks an authored route with a vista, a stop beside a tool screen and a bench seat; a short say each; Crimson sets a waypoint to Rime Vault; Ember guides to the Signal Rise home.
changes.characters: Package directory assets characters/<id>/ (object.json, object.glb, thumbnail.png), byte-identical to com.hyprune.starter@0.1.1; self-contained because core resolves library assets only against an installed id@version and installers do not install world library dependencies yet.
changes.benches: Sun Court seats lowered from 0.61 to 0.40 m; new 0.40 m benches in Array Hall (open floor between the desks, facing the hanging wall), Rime Vault (south edge, facing the vista) and Signal Rise (open south field, facing the fortress); 10 seat anchors. Anchors sit 0.16 m behind the visual seat front with seat collision set back to match, so the seated pelvis is 0.19-0.25 m inside the front edge and at least 0.6 m from the bench ends; no obstacle within 0.3 m of any used bench (floor to seat + 1.3 m).
changes.keepClear: 11 volumes: in front of the four primary walls and at the doors between areas.
changes.interactions: Waypoint and guide labels name the action: "Way to Rime Vault" (Crimson) and "Show me Signal Rise" (Ember). Say lines are 36 characters or fewer. A seated resident asked to guide stands, steps off, guides and sits again.
changes.anchorFaces: Path stops face scene anchors by id again (core loads anchors before paths).
